data.content_ref: inline:Strengthen the grounded extension by adding an explicit defeat-priority total order over attacks, computed by a canonical polynomial-time rule. A node is accepted if it is defended against all higher-priority attackers, and reinstatement becomes a consequence of priority order rather than an emergent property. Criticizable because any priority order introduces arbitrary tie-breaking that may not reflect evidence strength, and the rule may be manipulable by synthetic edge ordering.
